data.completion_memo: Implemented strict runtime-validated command receipts and ordered event projections with immutable state, stale gap fencing, client IDs, and explicit snapshot resynchronization.
data.description: Implement the sole strict-TypeScript gateway to the Trusted Core with runtime schema validation, client command IDs, receipt tracking, ordered sequence gating, pure reducers/selectors, immutable feature projections, snapshot/delta resynchronization, and stale-state handling. React and widget types must remain downstream of this kernel.
data.title: M07.2 — Implement deterministic command and event projections
